purpose: Non-production static-OTP customer login API; local/DEV receive a default fixture while UAT accounts must be provisioned explicitly.
dataOwnership: Reads the local/dev/UAT-capable uat_seed_accounts table; UAT has no default row.
Projects valid UAT identities into production customer identity tables.
Creates real customer_sessions rows and stores only token hashes.
Profile reads are resolved from the active backend session token.
securityRules: The endpoint is disabled unless an active Spring profile is local, dev, or uat.
OTP must be exactly six digits.
